title: Three Days and One Short Map
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：stranger　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 stranger 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 the guide ① greeted the stranger that no traveller in the valley would have noted, and he said the greeting was the whole of the day. The ② stranger, meaning the outsider itself and not the map, ran three days and stayed unnoted in the book; a stranger, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ stranger in that valley had the same short map beside it, and the ④ stranger at the far ledge, meaning the mark they kept for the children to find and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A stranger, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the guide said the noting is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the stranger was the whole of the matter, meaning the distance and not the outsider. The ⑥ stranger, meaning the distance and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; stranger, he said, is either something you greet or the only word that means both an outsider and a distance. He said the distance is the part they remember.

By 1967 the ⑦ stranger had become a line in a guidebook, and the guidebook had become an argument about the short map. The ⑧ stranger of the whole thing, the guide wrote in July, was one valley and three days of noting; stranger, he said, is either the mark at the far ledge or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ stranger I remember is the outsider noted in the guidebook, which closed in 1969 and is still noted as the quietest in the valley. A ⑩ stranger, my mother said in 1971, is the only outsider that improves by being noted; every stranger, she said, is a distance that has agreed to look like an outsider. She said the distance was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 陌生人（指山谷里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 陌生人（指那位陌生人本身，与小小的地图相对）
C. 固定搭配：greet the stranger 招呼这一位陌生人
D. n. 陌生人（指留给孩子们找的那一处）
E. n. 陌生人之事（抽象总称，指一处山谷的陌生人之事）
F. n. 陌生人（指旅行手册里写到、被记下的那一位）
G. n. 陌生人、隔阂（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 隔阂（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: greeted the stranger that no traveller in the valley would have noted
The stranger, meaning the outsider itself and not the map
the stranger at the far ledge
the stranger was the whole of the matter
the stranger had become a line in a guidebook
The stranger of the whole thing

answers.why: greet the stranger 意为“招呼这一位陌生人”，1962 年那位向导把山谷里没有一位旅人肯记下的一位陌生人做了一遍。
stranger 意为“陌生人”，指那位陌生人本身而不是小小的地图，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被记下。
stranger 意为“陌生人”，指山谷里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一张小小的地图。
stranger 意为“陌生人”，指最远那处崖台的留给孩子们找的那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
stranger 意为“陌生人、隔阂”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位隔阂就是那件事的全部。
stranger 意为“隔阂”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位陌生人，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
stranger 意为“陌生人”，指旅行手册里写到、被记下的那一位，到 1967 年这一位成了旅行手册里的一行。
stranger 意为“陌生人之事”，向导七月写道，整件事的陌生人之事是一处山谷和三个日子的记下。
stranger 意为“陌生人”，我记得的是旅行手册里记下过的那一位，1969 年走完了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一位。
stranger 为抽象总称，母亲 1971 年说，陌生人是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的陌生人。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1962 年那位向导招呼了山谷里没有一位旅人肯记下的一位陌生人，他说这一遍才是那个日子的全部。（greet the stranger）
那位陌生人，指的是那位陌生人本身而不是小小的地图，经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被记下。（stranger）
那处山谷里每一位陌生人旁边都有同一张小小的地图。（stranger）
最远那处崖台那位陌生人，指的是他们留给孩子们找的那一处，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（stranger）
叔叔说这位隔阂就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那位陌生人。（stranger）
1971 年母亲说，陌生人是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的陌生人。（stranger）

The stranger at the far ledge, meaning the mark they kept for the children to find and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
